title: Set a condition
instructions: Read the whole sentence, then choose the word.

parts.prompt: The club will hold the sale outdoors ___ it rains on Saturday, when it will move to the hall.

choice_rationales.A: Although would mean the outdoor sale goes ahead despite the rain, but the sale moves to the hall.
choice_rationales.B: Rain is not the reason for holding the sale outdoors.
choice_rationales.C: While would mean both happen at once, but the sale moves if it rains.
choice_rationales.D: Unless means ‘except if’: the sale is outdoors except when it rains.

parts.hint: What must happen for the sale to move?
parts.correct_explanation: The sale stays outdoors except in one case, and unless shows that condition.
